name: glyhub_GPST000533_N_Released
title: Desialylated haptoglobin released N-glycans in sepsis serum
description: Haptoglobin purified from healthy-control and sepsis serum was analyzed by LC-ESI MS after desialylation. The complete source feature matrix contains three HC0, three SG1 and three SG2 observations.
details: PNGase F-released glycans were labeled with aminoxy tandem mass tag (aTMT6); distinct core- and Lewis-fucosylated chromatographic labels remain separate. Source intensity is the assay; author percentages are preserved separately. No normalization, replicate pooling or composition-from-mass reconstruction is applied. Antennarity and fucosylation labels are mapped to the explicit source SNFG residue counts.

name: glyhub_GPST000533_N_Glycopeptides
title: Desialylated haptoglobin glycopeptides in sepsis serum
description: Haptoglobin purified from healthy-control and sepsis serum was analyzed by LC-ESI MS after desialylation. The complete six-panel source table contains three HC0, three SG1 and three SG2 observations.
details: The source protein is UniProt P00738. All six quantitative panels in the selected author sheet are retained: Site 3 (3+), Site 4 (4+ and 3+), Site 2 (3+ and 2+), and oxidized Site 1 (3+). Charge states are distinct features, not independent samples, and are not summed. All panels have matching sample and raw-data identifiers. Source Site 1 binding position 84 conflicts with the listed peptide interval 179-194, so typed protein_site is NA for that panel. Other site positions are retained directly. Source intensity is the assay; author percentages are preserved separately. No normalization, replicate pooling or composition-from-mass reconstruction is applied. Antennarity and fucosylation labels are source annotations. Compositions are transcribed from explicit SNFG residue counts in Supplementary Figures 1d/e and 2a, linked through author glycan labels. Unknown linkages and ambiguous fucose attachment are not inferred.
